hypothesis: More training under the fixed Win objective can improve natural-start A20 Act1 full clear probability; no claim that reaching 70M necessarily improves it.
control: frozen 56M champion evaluated on exactly the same development seeds/runtime
experimental_variable: additional training budget under Win-only reward; no lambda/normalization/critic/lr/native changes
training_seed_handling: continue saved next_seed and all RNG state; no new training seed or reset
primary_endpoint: 70M fixed-budget endpoint versus frozen champion; selected-best is separately confirmed and secondary
success_rule: primary paired delta >= 0.02, exact McNemar p<0.05 and lower 95% paired interval>0, all health counters zero; secondary selected model must not clearly contradict. One training seed limits recipe generalization.
failure_rule: endpoint and selected model both have upper paired 95% interval <= 0, or reproducible runtime failure. Otherwise inconclusive; do not automatically add steps.
after_no_improvement: Stop pure budget extension. Use measured critic/advantage/credit evidence to choose one Win-only lambda or normalization experiment; do not conclude lambda is broken from lambda**T alone.
reproducibility: state-preserving implementation fork, not exact 4b4028c continuation; PPO KL diagnostic sampling and selection changed, source digests pinned; full losses/model/reward/native/worker layout unchanged
final_policy: Do not consume 9e12 during training. Freeze one candidate/hash/runtime/batching and baseline using development only, then evaluate 4096 paired final seeds once. No selection on final. Real stock-game full-run claims require stock-game trials.
